'''Electronic vouchers''' were a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were an electronic device rather than hard currency so they could be traced.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
